Functional indexed updates

Source: R/numpy_indexing.R
at.Rd

Ports of the x.at[idx] methods of JAX arrays: at_get is x.at[idx].get(), at_set is x.at[idx].set(value), and likewise add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, min, max and apply. The index arguments in ... follow the rules of [.jax_value. None of these modify x; they return a new array. With repeated indices all updates are applied (in an unspecified order for at_set).

Usage

at_get(
  x,
  ...,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL,
  fill_value = NULL,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE,
  strategy = "auto"
)

at_set(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_add(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_subtract(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_multiply(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_divide(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_power(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_min(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_max(
  x,
  ...,
  value,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

at_apply(
  x,
  ...,
  func,
  mode = NULL,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  wrap_negative_indices = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

Array.

...

Index arguments (see jax_indexing).

indices_are_sorted

Whether the indices are known to be sorted.

unique_indices

Whether the indices are known to be free of duplicates.

mode

Out of bounds mode: "clip", "fill" or "drop", "promise_in_bounds". By default reads clamp indices and updates drop out of bounds indices.

fill_value

Value returned for out of bounds indices with mode = "fill".

wrap_negative_indices

Whether negative indices count from the end.

strategy

One of "auto", "gather", "static_slice", "dynamic_slice".

value

Update values, broadcast to the indexed shape.

func

Unary function applied at the indices (not differentiable).

Value

An array.
